headings.usage: Used for all major section titles, manifesto numbers, quotes, and the primary hero heading. Use tight tracking (tracking-tight) for large sizes.

body.usage: Used for all paragraphs, buttons, UI elements, navigation, and small labels. Keep tracking normal, loose line-height (leading-relaxed) for readability.

primary.name: Rutuja Blue
primary.usage: Trust, structure, navigation, primary call-to-actions, and structural borders.

secondary.name: Rutuja Pink
secondary.usage: Emotional emphasis, key highlight words in text, secondary CTAs, and storytelling accents. Use sparingly.

background.usage: 70-80% of the UI should be these white/soft neutral colors to let typography and imagery breathe.

text.usage: Primary text for headings and strong body content. Secondary for standard body content. Muted for captions.

borders.usage: Very light neutral grey for subtle dividers and minimal card outlines. Never harsh black borders.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. Use gap-12 to gap-24 for grid layouts.
layouts.grids: Use asymmetric layouts (e.g., col-span-5 for text, col-span-7 for image) to create tension and an editorial feel.
layouts.alignment: Mix of center alignment for majestic section headers (like 'Meet the Dignity Doll') and left-aligned structured grids for 'How It Works'.
layouts.corners: Minimal border radius. Use rounded-sm or rounded-none for images and buttons to maintain a premium editorial feel, instead of playful heavy rounded corners.

motion.scroll: MUST install and use `lenis` or `@studio-freight/react-lenis` for buttery smooth scrolling.
motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal using `framer-motion`. Wrap lines in `overflow-hidden` and animate `y` from `100%` to `0%`.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on hero images and large section background images using `framer-motion` useScroll.
motion.marquee: Slow, elegant editorial marquee for 'Stories From the Field' or partner logos. Use `react-fast-marquee`.
motion.micro_interactions: Subtle hover lifts (`-translate-y-1`), image scale up within `overflow-hidden` containers on hover.

components.navigation: Sticky nav. Initially transparent (`bg-transparent`), transitions to solid white (`bg-white shadow-sm`) upon scroll. Must include an EN | हिंदी toggle.

buttons.primary: bg-[#295EAA] text-white hover:bg-[#204985] px-6 py-3 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-[#C82B62] text-white hover:bg-[#A3234F] px-6 py-3 transition-colors
buttons.outline: bg-transparent border border-[#295EAA] text-[#295EAA] hover:bg-[#295EAA] hover:text-white px-6 py-3 transition-colors

components.forms: Use Shadcn UI inputs and textareas for `/request-workshop`, `/donate`, `/partner`, `/contact`. Style them with minimal borders (`border-b` only, or very light full borders) for an elegant look.
components.accordion: Use Shadcn Accordion for the FAQ section. Large typography, thin dividers.
components.mobile_bar: Fixed bottom CTA bar on mobile screens with 'Donate' and 'Request Workshop' buttons.

hero_dignity_doll.description: Placeholder for the Dignity Doll. Neutral, soft, human.

workshop_1.description: Indian women sitting in a group discussion, representing the workshop experience.

workshop_2.description: Group of Indian women in colorful saris, suitable for stories from the field.

school_girls.description: Two young Indian girls sitting at a desk, smiling, representing the 'Who it is for' or impact sections.

portrait_girl.description: Portrait of a young Indian girl, great for an alternating text/image layout.

instructions_to_main_agent: Set up Tailwind to include 'Playfair Display' (serif) and 'Manrope' (sans).
Use standard HTML structure for layout, applying heavy Tailwind paddings (`py-24`, `py-32`) to let the design breathe. Do NOT rely heavily on standard Shadcn `Card` for marketing sections.
Implement the sticky navbar with background transition based on scroll position.

Build the 12 specific sections on the homepage: Hero, Why This Matters, Meet the Dignity Doll, How It Works, Stories From the Field, Impact Metrics, Who It Is For, Workshop Experience, Ways to Support, Trust & Credibility, FAQ, Final CTA.
Create the placeholder routing pages (/request-workshop, /donate, etc.) with functional Shadcn forms.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.
Add an EN | हिंदी toggle state in the nav. It can just switch dummy content or show a toast indicating language switch for now.
Ensure the hero has a kinetic line-by-line reveal for the main heading.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts or uniform styling. Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters where appropriate (like the sticky nav). Do not apply universal transitions (`transition: all`). Do not center align the App container. Use layered design elements, overlapping images, and generous white space. Never use AI assistant emojis. Use the exact provided Rutuja Blue and Pink.
